correctness.rationale: Independent finite-field reconstruction from the six printed quasi-cyclic generator polynomials gives dimensions \(\dim C=9\), \(\dim D=5\), \(\dim D^\perp=9\), and rank \(14\) for \(C+D\). Fresh enumeration of all \(4^9\) words in each security-side code reproduces both displayed weight distributions exactly. Exhausting all \(2^{14}\) coordinate supports via restricted-column ranks reproduces the generalized Hamming-weight hierarchies \((4,6,7,9,10,11,12,13,14)\) and \((4,6,7,8,10,11,12,13,14)\). The different ordinary weight enumerators already rule out monomial equivalence, independently confirmed by the differing fourth generalized weight.
